author: dazwaz86
body:
On April 17 I was playing nebula and was reported and banned by Mango_. I believe this is an error for these following reasons. I was on a map with iron on a top floor and a lot of space to build things. I was attacking and trying to get the wool for our team to win. After a couple of times I realised a bunch of people making what they called a SHOP? A SHOP? I was destroying the SHOP because I believe that it was a waste of time and completely useless. Why are they making a SHOP when you are supposed to be trying to win and destroy the wool?? Plus, its not like you can even sell stuff?? Like seriously. That is just completely a waste of time and useless and just not participating in the game properly. I believe I should not be banned for these actions because I was trying to get them to participate as I even told them on the chat to stop building a SHOP! If it is so easy to ban people for these kinda things then that is ridiculous. 
Thank You, for your co-operation.

title: I WAS BANNED FOR NO REASON?

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
You are only Temporarily banned for 3 days. This Temp-ban ends 20th April.

We are going to appeal a valid temp-ban.
